cards.title: Biaya Perbaikan Rumah Aman
cards.text: Bayar 25 per Rumah Aman dan 100 per Markas milikmu.
cards.textEn: Pay 25 per Safe House and 100 per HQ you own.

cards.title: Telegram Terbuka
cards.text: Setiap pemain lain yang punya kartu Barang Curian wajib menunjukkan 1 (pilihannya) kepadamu secara rahasia.
cards.textEn: Every other player holding a Stolen Item card must secretly show you 1 of their choice.

cards.title: Rapat Agen
cards.text: Terima 20 escudo dari setiap pemain lain.
cards.textEn: Collect 20 escudos from every other player.

cards.title: Kode Dibakar
cards.text: Kamu tidak boleh mengajukan Dugaan pada giliran berikutnya.
cards.textEn: You may not make a Suggestion on your next turn.

cards.title: Kembali ke Dermaga
cards.text: Maju ke START dan terima gaji.
cards.textEn: Advance to START and collect salary.

cards.title: Laporan Intelijen
cards.text: Pemain di kananmu wajib menunjukkan 1 kartu Tersangka (pilihannya) kepadamu jika punya.
cards.textEn: The player on your right must show you 1 Suspect card of their choice, if they have one.

cards.title: Peta Kota Baru
cards.text: Pemain di kirimu wajib menunjukkan 1 kartu Lokasi (pilihannya) kepadamu jika punya.
cards.textEn: The player on your left must show you 1 Location card of their choice, if they have one.

cards.title: Panggilan ke Kantor Telegraf
cards.text: Pindah ke Kantor Telegraf dan mainkan Dekode. Jika melewati START, terima gaji.
cards.textEn: Move to the Telegraph Office and play Decode. Collect salary if you pass START.

cards.title: Kantong Diplomatik
cards.text: Terima Surat Bebas Diplomatik (simpan kartu ini).
cards.textEn: Receive a Diplomatic Release Letter (keep this card).

cards.title: Audit Keuangan
cards.text: Bayar 10% uang tunaimu (dibulatkan ke bawah) ke Brankas Kasino.
cards.textEn: Pay 10% of your cash (rounded down) to the Casino Vault.

cards.title: Rekrut Informan
cards.text: Terima 1 Dugaan tambahan dari petak mana pun dalam 3 giliranmu berikutnya (Lokasi bebas).
cards.textEn: Gain 1 extra Suggestion from any tile within your next 3 turns (any Location).
